owners.invariant: One immutable personal same-provider due-diligence review bound to exact report revision, evidence kind, validity window and cadence.
owners.mustPreserve: Risk adoption cannot close a gap or occur after closure; each review binds same provider/current report.

owners.declaredIdentity: tenant / linkId (equal to the admitting CommandId)

owners.invariant: One immutable accepted-risk linkage admitted on an open provider gap; source gap serializes duplicate tuple and closure. Never owns gap closure.
owners.mustPreserve: Risk adoption cannot close a gap or occur after closure; each review binds same provider/current report.

owners.invariant: One immutable assessment source/rule revision and findings.
owners.mustPreserve: No projected latest assessment or gap list can authorize entry; all exceptions/required plans acknowledged.

owners.invariant: One stable gap action/owner/date plan and independent annotations; admission/seal generation fences changes during a readiness decision.
owners.mustPreserve: No projected latest assessment or gap list can authorize entry; all exceptions/required plans acknowledged.

owners.declaredIdentity: tenant/risks/riskId derived tenant+program+normalized identifier; createRequestId+initial content exact match; Revise only expected content revision with no request intent receipt.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / risks / RiskId; supplied RiskId must equal the unchanged tenant/program/normalized-identifier UUIDv5. Selected mutations use CommandId and exact authored-content revision.
owners.invariant: Normalized identifier has one creation identity/content within tenant/program and narrative updates require current revision. No additional risk-governance decision is made by this class.
owners.boundaryRationale: Retain independent authored risk identity/lifecycle and normalized identifier admission. No source establishes atomic narrative-assessment freshness requiring a merge. If a future domain rule introduces that coupling, reassess the narrow owner; repair current retry behavior now.

owners.declaredIdentity: tenant/risk-evaluations/riskId; assessment/acceptance IDs are stable request identities; shared evaluation Revision. Reused assessment compares only phase/score/method, acceptance only residual+approver, missing full changed intent comparison.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / risk-evaluations / RiskId, with immutable ProgramId and exact method/risk version. Selected CommandId binds assessment/acceptance intent and expected evaluation revision.
owners.invariant: Assessment phases follow inherent/current method; residual requires treatment and mitigate admission proof; acceptance must name current residual and accept treatment, satisfy score/appetite/authority/expiry, and be independent from assessor/owner unless exactly waived.
owners.boundaryRationale: Separating current treatment/residual from acceptance without a coordinating owner can accept stale terms. Keep a narrow risk assessment/acceptance decision context; independent historical assessment/acceptance decisions can have their own immutable IDs with current decision owner binding exact proofs.

owners.invariant: One risk’s governance and reassessment obligations.
owners.mustPreserve: Assessment belongs to RiskEvaluation; risk governance consumes exact risk/source proofs, no live aggregate authority.
